content:
sachin: Proposal: run envelope re-encrypt (KEK rotation) Thu 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC. Need RBAC prechecks + audit plan. Compatibility window? Canary plan?

maria: Ack. We must not give broad decrypt to humans. Plan: dedicated reencrypt-sa with only ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions. Also audit writes to immut logs.

jonathan: AWS/IAM sketch:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["kms:ReEncrypt*", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"
  }]
}
```
Keep this scoped to aliases + condition on source account.

alice: Multi-cloud notes: GCP needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on specific key versions; use conditional IAM for service accounts. Azure: assign Key Vault 'Key Operator' to the managed identity and limit to the key URI.

dave: Compatibility: runtime must accept both header v1 and v2 for at least 30d. Suggested flow: try v2 decrypt -> fall back to v1. Emit an event when fallback happens with key_id and service but no ciphertext.

maria: Audit logging: every re-encrypt op must emit a structured event: {op: "reencrypt", actor, source_key, target_key, object_id, success_bool, error_code}. Retention: 90d primary, archive 3y to S3 with integrity signature.

jonathan: Canary plan: pick 0.5% of writes from non-critical orgs for canary pass first 4 hours, then 5% for 24h, then ramp to 25% then full. If decrypt error rate > 0.5% or tail latency + p50 > 200ms, pause.

ops-bot: deploy-schedule: Reencrypt job scheduled 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z -> canary_start 02:05Z. Runbook link: https://playbooks/internal/reencrypt-kw.

alice: Rollback options: 1) stop re-encrypt job (no new re-encrypts) 2) if clients relying on new header, enable dual-decrypt flag in runtime 3) revert KEK alias switch (if atomic alias swap planned). Need runbook steps and a reverse migration script.

maria: RBAC change checklist before run: create reencrypt-sa, grant kms perms, add limited human operators group with approver role (read-only + can trigger job via ops-run). Approvers must be in audit log.

dave: vuln-triage note: if we discover a CVE that impacts DEK handling, stop. Keep snapshot backups of ciphertext metadata before touching objects. Tag reencrypted objects with new schema_version and migration_batch id.

jonathan: Observability: monitor metrics - reencrypt_success_rate, decrypt_fallback_count, reencrypt_latency_p95, key_errors_by_keyid. Add alerts: fallback_count > 50/min or error_rate > 0.5%.

maria: Audit export: sign and push daily manifests to bucket with KMS Envelope signature. Compliance wants proof of who triggered re-encrypt and key ids.

alice: Edge-cases: stale DEKs from long-lived caches -> add cache-flush hook in client libs and add header TTL for old DEK acceptance for 7 days after full rollout.

sachin: Outstanding asks: (1) list of service accounts to add to reencrypt role, (2) exact IAM snippets for GCP/Azure, (3) small test plan for canary which includes partial restores. Who owns each?

maria: I'll own RBAC + IAM snippets. jonathan will own canary automation and metrics. alice + dave will own runtime compatibility and rollback runbook. ops-bot: create incident channel when error threshold crossed.

infra-bot: FYI: created ticket INFRA-2345 for reencrypt infra changes.

sachin: Thanks — will assemble a short playbook and send for review tomorrow.
